title: Prayer for Mercy

questions.question: Oh that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains might quake at your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:1 (ESV): "that the mountains might quake at your presence—"

questions.question: As when fire kindles brushwood and the fire causes water to boil—to make your name known to your adversaries, and that the nations might tremble at your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:2 (ESV): "that the nations might tremble at your presence!"

questions.question: When you did awesome things that we did not look for, you came down, the mountains quaked at your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:3 (ESV): "the mountains quaked at your presence."

questions.question: From of old no one has heard or perceived by the ear, no eye has seen a God besides you, who acts for those who wait for whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:4 (ESV): "who acts for those who wait for him."

questions.question: You meet him who joyfully works righteousness, those who remember you in your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:5 (ESV): "those who remember you in your ways."

questions.question: Behold, you were angry, and we sinned; in our sins we have been a long time, and shall we be what?
We have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a polluted what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:6 (ESV): "all our righteous deeds are like a polluted garment."

questions.question: We all fade like a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, take us what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:6 (ESV): "like the wind, take us away."

questions.question: There is no one who calls upon your name, who rouses himself to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have made us melt in the hand of our what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:7 (ESV): "made us melt in the hand of our iniquities."

questions.question: But now, O LORD, you are our Father; we are the clay, and you are our what?
We are all the work of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 64:8 (ESV): "we are all the work of your hand."

questions.question: Be not so terribly angry, O LORD, and remember not iniquity forever. Behold, please look, we are all your what?
Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a what?
Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, has been burned by fire, and all our pleasant places have become what?
Will you restrain yourself at these things, O LORD? Will you keep silent, and afflict us so what?

key_verse_text: But now, O LORD, you are our Father; we are the clay, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand.
